title: Parametric Knowledge is Not All You Need: Toward Honest LLMs via Retrieval of Pretraining Data

summary.claim: LLMs become more honest when they decide whether to answer based on whether the answer exists in their pretraining data. RETAIN, which retrieves pretraining documents to judge answerability, beats R-Tuning by about 18 EM-F1 points.
summary.condition: Pythia-12b-deduped with its public Pile corpus; TIP-TriviaQA benchmark built from TriviaQA. Factual questions only.
summary.gap: (Authors) Tested only on a small model whose pretraining data is public (Pythia 12B); multi-hop and math questions are not covered.
